name: Castello di Guarene
niche_feature: Guests sleep in rooms and suites inside the 18th-century Baroque Castello di Guarene (built from 1726 over a medieval fort); room types are all Castle rooms/suites plus a Classic room, some beside the oldest spaces.
evidence_quote: Camere che accedono al cuore del Castello di Guarene. Sono le stanze adiacenti agli spazi più antichi
reason: Official site presents the whole hotel as the historic castle, with period rooms inside the Baroque building.

name: Castello di Montaldo
niche_feature: All 39 rooms and suites are in the medieval castle (founded c. 1011-1038, later a villa and Jesuit college), including suites in its towers and the former chapel.
evidence_quote: The castle, presumably founded between 1011 and 1038 under Landolfo Vescovo of Turin, was completed in approximately 1080
reason: Hotel occupies the whole medieval castle; rooms/suites described in the towers and old chapel.
page_issues: Page says 20 suites and 19 rooms; the official English rooms page lists 20 double rooms and 19 suites (12 Prestige, 4 Romantic, 2 Tower, 1 Diplomatic), while the Italian home page says 20 suites and 19 rooms.
3,000 m2 spa and Saunatur recognition not found on the pages checked.

name: Castello di Monterone
niche_feature: Eighteen rooms in an old medieval castle converted to a residenza d'epoca; the hotel says it is a real castle. Rooms are named for castle features (drawbridge, arrow slits, keys).
evidence_quote: Diciotto camere dotate di tutti i comfort, in un antico castello trasformato in Residenza d’Epoca e arredato nel rispetto della sua storia.
reason: All 18 rooms are inside the converted medieval castle, per the official site.
page_issues: Page says 13th-century; official history says the building dates back at least to the 11th century (documented 1200).

name: Castello di Oviglio
niche_feature: Nine rooms (4 suites, 2 junior suites, 3 comfort doubles) in the Castello di Oviglio, on the site of a fortified castrum documented from 1367; also a wedding and conference venue.
evidence_quote: Il Castello di Oviglio ospita oggi una realtà ricettiva di grande carattere, preservando gli ambienti e gli spazi originari.
reason: The nine bookable rooms are inside the historic castle per the official relais page.

name: Castello di Proceno
niche_feature: Albergo diffuso in the Proceno castle complex (pentagonal fortress with keep, two turrets, working drawbridge): apartments and suites in the fortino and courtyard, plus four rooms in a former wall tower. Separate farmhouse Il Giulione is outside the castle.
evidence_quote: Il Castello di Proceno è una fortezza a base pentagonale che comprende una torre principale e due torrette secondarie
reason: Apartments, suites and rooms are in the castle complex and its wall tower; the site also lets a separate farmhouse.
page_issues: Site also offers Il Giulione, a separate farmhouse 12 km away (6 rooms), not mentioned on the page.
Page says four rooms; apartments page lists three rooms (Caciaia, Collinella, Poggiolo) plus Belvedere.

name: Castello di Septe
niche_feature: 45 rooms in the restored Castello di Septe, an early-medieval (Lombard-era, 6th-8th century) hilltop castle declared a national monument; the hotel offers its rooms inside the castle.
evidence_quote: Restaurato con dedizione e dichiarato Monumento Nazionale dal Ministero dei Beni Culturali, oggi accoglie gli ospiti
reason: Official site presents the hotel as the whole restored castle; 45 rooms designed within the historic architecture.

name: Castello Fai
niche_feature: Three self-catering apartments (Torre del Baron, Residenza delle Contesse, and Castello Fai, which combines the two) in the same 17th-century hunting-lodge castle (Ciastel) in Fai della Paganella.
evidence_quote: The 170m² apartment is located on the ground floor of the castle, which consists of three residential units with separate entrances.
reason: All bookable units are apartments within the historic castle; it is apartments, not a hotel.
page_issues: The Castello Fai apartment is the Torre del Baron and Residenza delle Contesse units combined, not a separate third home.

name: Castello la Leccia
niche_feature: Hotel rooms are in the castle (documented since 1077, made villa-like in the 18th century, restored 2012); the adjacent Casa La Leccia apartment (5 doubles) is a separate building. Site never states exactly which building holds the 12 rooms.
evidence_quote: Il Castello sarà a vostra disposizione con le sue camere, i saloni, il ristorante, la piscina, la SPA
reason: Castle history documented and rooms described as the castle's; apartment next door is separate and the 12-room placement is only implied.
page_issues: Official site does not explicitly place the 12 rooms inside the castle; Casa La Leccia is a separate adjacent apartment.
Castle was altered in the 18th century to look more like a villa.

name: Castello Tafuri Charming Suites
niche_feature: Eighteen rooms and suites in Castello Tafuri, a crenellated villa built in castle form (designed 1933, started 1935, hotel from 1964, closed 1998 and reopened after renovation). Borderline: a 20th-century castle-style building, not a medieval fortress.
evidence_quote: Il committente Franzo Bruno di Belmonte affida la realizzazione di una villa in forma di castello all’architetto fiorentino
reason: All rooms are inside the castle-form villa; borderline because it dates from 1935, not a medieval castle.
page_issues: Page calls it a historic castle; the official history says it is a villa built in castle form from 1935 (hotel use 1964, closed 1998).
Site shows online booking under renewal and a 2021 copyright; current operating status could not be confirmed.

name: Dalhousie Castle
niche_feature: 35 rooms: Castle Classic, Deluxe, Junior Suite, Four Poster, Suite and two Feature Rooms are in the 800-year-old castle; Lodge rooms (Classic, Deluxe, Junior Suite, Suite) are a separate modern building in the grounds. Counts per group not given.
evidence_quote: Set within eleven acres of private parkland just outside Edinburgh, Dalhousie Castle has stood for over 800 years.
reason: Real medieval castle, but only the Castle-category rooms are inside it; Lodge rooms are separate.
page_issues: Page says it describes itself as Scotland's oldest inhabited castle; the current official site says one of Scotland's oldest inhabited castles.

name: Dornoch Castle Hotel
niche_feature: 9 of 21 rooms are inside the 15th-century castle; the other 12 are in a modern extension.
evidence_quote: featuring 21 rooms – nine are located within our 15th-century castle, while the remaining twelve rooms are set within our modern extension
reason: Genuine 15th-century castle, but only nine of 21 rooms are inside it.

name: Dromoland Castle
niche_feature: Suites are set within the original castle walls; the site does not state where its other castle room categories sit. Castle is the 1835 Gothic Revival rebuild of the O'Brien seat, hotel since 1963. Self-catering lodges are separate.
evidence_quote: set within the original Castle Walls, each unique suite is a self-contained slice of heaven.
reason: Genuine castle hotel; only the suites are explicitly in the castle. Castle currently closed for refurbishment, bookings from May 2027 (lodges open).
page_issues: Official site says the castle is temporarily closed for refurbishment; castle bookings from May 2027, self-catering lodges still open.
Page says castle built in the 16th century; the current building dates from 1835 (Gothic Revival, per Wikipedia).
Claims about old stone-tower rooms vs newer wing, 9.3 rating and 1,247 reviews were not confirmed by the official site.
